# Cork & Route

> Bespoke photography and intimate elopement experiences in Summit County, Colorado.

Cork & Route is a photography studio specializing in storytelling-driven elopements, intimate weddings, engagements, couples sessions, and destination photography throughout the Colorado Rockies.

## Service Area

* Summit County, Colorado
* Breckenridge, Colorado
* Frisco, Colorado
* Dillon, Colorado
* Silverthorne, Colorado
* Keystone, Colorado
* Copper Mountain, Colorado
* Vail Valley, Colorado

## About

Cork & Route creates editorial-inspired photography with a documentary approach, capturing authentic moments in mountain environments. We specialize in intimate celebrations, adventurous elopements, and bespoke experiences designed around each couple.

Based in Summit County, Colorado, Cork & Route serves couples seeking meaningful wedding and elopement experiences in the Rocky Mountains and beyond.

## Core Services

* Elopement Photography
* Adventure Elopements
* Intimate Wedding Photography
* Engagement Sessions
* Couples Photography
* Proposal Photography
* Destination Photography
* Mountain Portrait Sessions

## Short Description

Cork & Route documents intimate weddings, elopements, engagements, and adventure sessions throughout Colorado's mountain communities, creating timeless imagery rooted in place, connection, and authentic storytelling.
